body:
Devon: quick postmortem follow-up  owners + 10-day plan for streaming/chat reliability (timeouts, partials, reconnects).
Anya: keep it short: owner + due date + one metric.
Devon: three workstreams: reconnect/backoff, partial-detect+safe-resume, telemetry + canary safety.
Matt: I9ll own reconnect/backoff. prototype jittered exponential client lib, server handshake flag to decline stale resumes.
Lia: I9ll own partial-detection and safe-resume. building a small harness to replay chunks and force-close sockets to validate idempotent resumes.
incident-bot: created INC-9012 "streaming resiliency follow-up" https://tracker/redwood/INC-9012
Matt: compact timeline: days 0-2 lib + flag, days 3-5 staging matrix, day 6 10% canary, day 7-10 ramp.
Anya: acceptance (one-liners): reconnect success >=99.5% within 30s; partials down >=90%; token-latency regression <=5%.
Lia: must emit metrics: resume_attempts, resume_success_rate, duplicate_resume_count. resumes must be safe to retry.
Devon: SRE to attach canary runbook and rollback triggers. suggested auto-rollback: streaming error rate >0.5% for 5m OR token-latency >2x baseline for 3m.
SRE-Bot: runbook attached to INC-9012; rollback criteria configured.
Anya: telemetry tasks: alert when partial_chunk_rate >0.1% over 5m; dashboard per-route resume latency; trace sampling for failed resumes.
Devon: recurring pattern note: spikes ~03:00 UTC on low-load pools. infra to test aggressive TCP keepalive on a small canary pool.
Owners & targets: Matt (reconnect/backoff + canary) due 2026-04-06; Lia (partial harness + resume) due 2026-04-04; Anya (telemetry + QA sign-off) due 2026-04-08; SRE (runbook) done.
Devon: weekly 20-30m sync Mondays starting 2026-03-30. post short status here: "ok/blocker/done".
Matt: PR target day 4, will ping reviewers.
Lia: harness started, ETA 5 days, will attach logs to INC-9012.
Anya: will post staging numbers Monday.
Devon: if blocked, tag #eng-oncall and ping this thread.
